_meta.purpose: Mock 兜底数据,source_type 全部标记为 mock,报告中可清晰区分。覆盖 3 产品 × 4 claim_type

convention.source_type: mock — 报告中显示为 mock 来源,不与真实数据混淆
convention.claim: 中文摘要,Analyzer 提炼后可直接进入 Schema
convention.evidence_id: S + 7 hex chars = 8 字符;Demo 数据用语义化前缀(CABE=Cursor, DEAD=Windsurf, FACE=Copilot)

raw_evidence.claim: Cursor 支持跨代码库的多行代码编辑预测,通过 Tab 键快速接受
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Cursor predicts your next edit, so you can breeze through changes by pressing tab. Powered by a custom model, it can suggest multi-line edits across your codebase.

raw_evidence.claim: Cursor Agent 模式可端到端执行任务,跨文件编辑 + 终端命令
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Agent mode can complete tasks end-to-end, executing terminal commands, reading the entire codebase, and editing multiple files in a single conversation.

raw_evidence.claim: Cursor 通过 Cmd+K 进行内联代码编辑,基于自然语言指令重写选中片段
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Press Cmd+K to edit code inline. Cursor will rewrite the selection based on your natural language instruction, with a diff preview before applying.

raw_evidence.claim: Windsurf Cascade 是实时协作型 Agent,可读代码、建议编辑、协作执行命令
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Cascade is Windsurf's flagship feature: an AI agent that works with you in real time, reading your codebase, suggesting edits, and running commands collaboratively without forcing you out of flow.

raw_evidence.claim: Windsurf Supercomplete 基于近期编辑历史预测下一步操作,而非仅光标位置
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Supercomplete predicts your next action with awareness of recent edits across files, not just the cursor position. It can suggest deletions, refactors, and new code in flow.

raw_evidence.claim: GitHub Copilot 提供 100+ 语言的内联代码补全,支持主流 IDE
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: GitHub Copilot provides AI-powered code completions inline as you type, available in 100+ languages and across major IDEs including VS Code, JetBrains, Visual Studio, Vim/Neovim.

raw_evidence.claim: Copilot Chat 支持 VS Code/JetBrains/GitHub Web 内自然语言代码问答
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Copilot Chat lets you ask questions about your code in natural language within VS Code, JetBrains, and the GitHub web interface. Can reference files, terminals, and issues as context.

raw_evidence.claim: Copilot Workspace(测试)支持从 Issue 到 PR 的端到端 AI 编辑,跨文件方案规划
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Copilot Workspace (beta) lets you take an issue from idea to PR, with AI proposing a plan, then edits across multiple files. Currently in technical preview.

raw_evidence.claim: Cursor sometimes hallucinates completions that look correct but have subtle bugs
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: [HN comment] Cursor sometimes hallucinates completions that look correct but have subtle bugs. I spent an hour debugging a completion that had an off-by-one error.

raw_evidence.claim: Copilot suggestions can be distracting when working on niche languages with poor support
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: [HN comment] Copilot suggestions can be distracting when working on niche languages. The completions are often wrong for Rust lifetimes and I end up pressing Esc more than Tab.

raw_evidence.claim: Windsurf extension occasionally freezes VS Code when indexing large monorepos
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: [HN comment] Windsurf extension occasionally freezes VS Code when indexing large monorepos. Had to disable it on our 500k LOC project.

raw_evidence.claim: Cursor Pro plan at $20/month includes unlimited completions and 500 fast premium requests
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: Cursor Pro: $20/month - Unlimited completions, 500 fast premium requests per month, unlimited slow premium requests.

raw_evidence.claim: GitHub Copilot Individual at $10/month, Business at $19/user/month
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: GitHub Copilot Individual: $10/month or $100/year. Business: $19/user/month. Enterprise: $39/user/month.

raw_evidence.claim: Cursor Tab completion latency is around 200ms on M2 Mac, feels instant
raw_evidence.extracted_snippet: [HN comment] Cursor Tab completion latency is around 200ms on my M2 Mac. It feels instant compared to Copilot which takes 500ms+.
